𝗛𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝘄𝗲𝗲𝗻 𝗖𝗼𝘀𝗽𝗹𝗮𝘆 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝘀𝘁: 𝗦𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝗢𝗳𝗳 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗦𝗽𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘆
𝗦𝘁𝘆𝗹𝗲! 👻🎃
It’s time to put on your Halloween outfit and show
your creativity! Whether you cosplay your favorite
Top Heroes character or create your own unique
Halloween look, we can’t wait to see your amazing
entries!

🎃 𝗘𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲
October 31 – November 7

📸 𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗶𝗽𝗮𝘁𝗲
1. Wear your favorite Halloween costume, or share
Halloween-themed items, decorations, scenes, or
anything with a festive atmosphere. Be creative!
2. Share your photo in the comments under this post.
3. Please include your In-Game Name and Server ID
so we can send rewards if you win.

🎁 𝗘𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗥𝗲𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀
Lucky Rewards:
After the event ends, we will randomly select 15
eligible participants. Each winner will receive a $4.99
Gold Block reward!
Community Unlock Reward:
When this event reaches 777 participants across all
platforms, a Halloween gift code will be unlocked as a
community-wide reward for all Lords!

📅 𝗥𝗲𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗱 𝗗𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗯𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻
1. Lucky Rewards will be sent on the next business
day after the event ends.
2. The community gift code will be announced
through the official community after the goal is
reached.

📌 𝗡𝗼𝘁𝗲
By submitting your photo under this post, you agree
that the official community may use your content for
event showcases, community posts, or promotional
purposes.

*Show us your creative Halloween style and enjoy a
spooky, fun-filled Halloween together! Good luck,
Lords! 🎃🕸️
